title: English Local Authority
summary: Adds value streams — Apply for a service, Report a problem, Pay the council and Get support — grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome residents experience.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for an English local authority, v2: adds value streams (ADR-023) — Apply for a service, Report a problem, Pay the council, Get support — each grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome residents experience. Capability items are unchanged from v1 (codes 1-12). Stream content was drafted this sprint (F6) for the reviewer; reviewed by Simon Parkinson, 2026-09-21.

sources.citation: Socitm Local Public Services Business Capability Model (consulted for scope and level-1 shape; not copied)
Care Act 2014, Children Act 1989/2004 and the Local Government Finance Act 1992 (statutory duties consulted for sector-specific capabilities)
UK Government Functional Standards GovS 001-016 (consulted for the shared corporate capabilities)

items.name: Finance
items.description: Planning, controlling and accounting for the organisation's money and financial risk.

items.name: Financial Planning & Budgeting
items.description: Setting medium-term financial plans and annual budgets aligned to priorities.

items.name: Financial Accounting & Reporting
items.description: Recording transactions and producing statutory accounts and management reports.

items.name: Treasury & Cash Management
items.description: Managing cash, borrowing, investments and liquidity to meet obligations.

items.name: Payments & Receivables
items.description: Paying suppliers and collecting income owed to the organisation.

items.name: Financial Control & Audit Support
items.description: Maintaining internal controls and evidence for internal and external audit.

items.name: Human Resources
items.description: Attracting, developing, rewarding and retaining the people the organisation needs.

items.name: Workforce Planning
items.description: Forecasting the roles, numbers and skills the organisation will need.

items.name: Recruitment & Onboarding
items.description: Sourcing, selecting and settling new people into their roles.

items.name: Learning & Development
items.description: Building the skills, knowledge and behaviours the workforce needs.

items.name: Pay, Reward & Pensions
items.description: Administering pay, benefits and pension arrangements accurately and on time.

items.name: Employee Relations & Wellbeing
items.description: Supporting fair treatment, health, safety and engagement of employees.

items.name: Procurement
items.description: Obtaining goods, works and services that offer value for money and manage supply risk.

items.name: Category & Sourcing Strategy
items.description: Deciding how each category of spend is best sourced and competed.

items.name: Tendering & Contract Award
items.description: Running compliant competitions and awarding contracts to suppliers.

items.name: Contract & Supplier Management
items.description: Managing supplier performance, relationships and risk through the contract life.

items.name: Spend Control & Compliance
items.description: Ensuring purchases follow policy, thresholds and approved suppliers.

items.name: Information Management
items.description: Governing, protecting and exploiting the organisation's information as an asset.

items.name: Records Management
items.description: Creating, keeping and disposing of records according to retention rules.

items.name: Data Governance & Quality
items.description: Defining ownership, standards and quality controls for the organisation's data.

items.name: Information Rights & Access
items.description: Meeting freedom of information, subject access and transparency obligations.

items.name: Data Protection & Privacy
items.description: Ensuring personal data is processed lawfully, securely and proportionately.

items.name: Analytics & Business Intelligence
items.description: Turning data into insight that informs decisions and performance management.

items.name: Customer Contact
items.description: Handling enquiries, requests and feedback from the people the organisation serves.

items.name: Contact Channels

items.name: Identity & Account Verification
items.description: Confirming who a customer is before acting on their behalf.

items.name: Case & Request Tracking
items.description: Recording each request and its progress until it is resolved.

items.name: Complaints & Feedback

items.name: Accessibility & Inclusion

items.name: Estates

items.name: Property Portfolio & Strategy

items.name: Facilities & Building Operations
items.description: Running buildings day to day: cleaning, security, utilities and reception.

items.name: Maintenance & Compliance
items.description: Keeping buildings safe, compliant and in good repair over their life.

items.name: Space & Workplace
items.description: Allocating and configuring space to how people actually work.

items.name: Energy & Sustainability
items.description: Reducing the energy, carbon and environmental impact of the estate.

items.name: Digital & Technology
items.description: Delivering and running the technology and digital services the organisation depends on.

items.name: Enterprise Architecture & Standards
items.description: Setting the target technology landscape and the standards it follows.

items.name: Application Delivery & Support
items.description: Building, buying, integrating and supporting the applications the business runs on.

items.name: Infrastructure, Cloud & Networks
items.description: Providing the compute, storage, hosting and connectivity services rely on.

items.name: Cyber Security & Resilience
items.description: Protecting systems and data from threats and recovering from disruption.

items.name: Digital Service Design
items.description: Designing user-centred digital services around real user needs.

items.name: Technology Service Management

items.name: Governance & Assurance

items.name: Strategy & Performance

items.name: Risk Management

items.name: Internal Audit & Assurance

items.name: Corporate Governance

items.name: Business Continuity & Emergency Planning

items.name: Needs Assessment & Care Planning

items.name: Commissioned Care & Support

items.name: Safeguarding Adults

items.name: Direct Payments & Personal Budgets
items.description: Giving people control of the money spent on their care.

items.name: Carers Support
items.description: Assessing and supporting the needs of unpaid carers.

items.name: Public Health & Prevention
items.description: Commissioning services that protect and improve the population's health.

items.name: Children's Services & Education
items.description: Educating, protecting and supporting children, young people and families.

items.name: School Place Planning & Admissions
items.description: Ensuring enough school places and allocating them fairly.

items.name: Special Educational Needs & Disabilities
items.description: Assessing and meeting the needs of children with SEND.

items.name: Safeguarding & Children's Social Care
items.description: Protecting children from harm and supporting families in need of help.

items.name: Early Help & Family Support

items.name: Looked-After Children & Care Leavers

items.name: Place & Infrastructure

items.name: Highways & Transport

items.name: Waste & Recycling

items.name: Environmental Health & Trading Standards

items.name: Licensing

items.name: Revenues, Benefits & Welfare

items.name: Council Tax & Business Rates

items.name: Housing Benefit

items.name: Discretionary & Household Support

items.name: Money & Welfare Advice
items.description: Helping residents maximise their income, claim entitlements and manage debt.
